summary: SMART-TC iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass for level_part enum, stored status field, PATCH /spare-parts/{id} permissions + edit_history audit, lampiran_status, pagination skip/limit, level_part filter, foto_datang, backfill, indexes. Frontend: SMART-TC branding (login + sidebar + browser title), form validation with red borders + inline errors + toast + summary, Level Part dropdown saves, Detail page shows Level badge + Lampiran card + Edit Info dialog (creator-only), Edit History card appears after edit, /database page has LEVEL/LAMPIRAN columns + filter-level dropdown. Permission gating confirmed: Zulkifli (other user) cannot see Edit Info button on Cindy's part.

minor.issue: Empty strings pass for required str fields (line_area, nama_barang, etc.). Spec acknowledges frontend validation handles this, but backend could add Field(min_length=1) for defensive validation.

issues: /database route exists and works but is not linked in sidebar (Dashboard, Line/Area, Laporan Bulanan, User Management, Setting). Users must know the URL or navigate from another page. Consider adding 'Database' or 'List Data' sidebar item.

action_items: Optional: link /database in sidebar nav for discoverability
Optional: add Pydantic Field(min_length=1) on required SparePartCreate string fields for defense-in-depth (frontend validation already enforces this)
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /spare-parts/{id} permission logic correct: is_creator OR is_requestor; others receive 403 (verified).
edit_history append uses $push with single entry; idempotent on no-change (returns part without modifying edit_history) — verified.
Stored `status` field updated atomically inside _update_stage via compute_status(merged) — eliminates Python-side filtering; backed by MongoDB index status_1.
Indexes verified: status_1, level_part_1, line_area_1_status_1, order_tanggal_-1, requestor_id_1, users.nik unique, files.path unique — all present.
Backfill at startup is idempotent (uses $exists guards) — safe across restarts.
PATCH `lampiran_status` change does write an edit_history entry (treated as a normal field change) — this is correct & desirable for audit, confirmed.
server.py is now ~810 lines — borderline. Consider splitting into modules in next iteration.
Token still passed via ?auth= for file fetch — already noted in iter1; acceptable for img tags.
